query: I was walking around the city center earlier and tried the local matcha latte from that little corner shop everyone posts about, it’s so creamy and not bitter at all, I even picked up a small tin to bring back home for my mom. On the way back to my hotel I stopped at a street market and got a hand-carved wooden keychain that has the city’s skyline on it, it’s such a nice little souvenir. I was just about to text my friend a photo of it when I realized I can’t get any mobile data or send any texts at all right now, I have airplane mode turned on and I’m abroad with roaming turned off, can you help me figure out why my mobile service isn’t working?
